hall_stallholder.text: Good morning! Buns, bread, a few antiques and the odd Roman coin that isn't. What have you for me?
Do have a look at the board. We pride ourselves on being fair and on being behind the Guildhall.
Thank you so much. Do pop back. We're always here. It's very small.

stall_bath_pitch.text: This pitch is up for the taking, if you fancy it. Cakes sell themselves, mostly.
